headlines.title: Meta’s glasses will turn off the camera if you tamper with the privacy light
headlines.author: Victoria Song
headlines.excerpt: Amid public backlash over its smart glasses, Meta announced that it will be updating its glasses with a new feature that will disable the camera when it detects that someone has tampered with or destroyed the glasses' privacy LED light.
